title: Agricultural ecosystem relevance targets
description: Actors, operational entities and Flaha capabilities for which intelligence may be relevant without constituting a recommendation.

terms.label: Farmer
terms.definition: A person or household responsible for agricultural production decisions.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Use when information may materially affect farmer decisions or welfare; do not infer an identified farmer record.

terms.label: Farm
terms.definition: An agricultural operating unit comprising land, facilities, livestock or production activities.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Use for farm-level operational relevance; do not create or infer a Knowledge Platform farm entity.

terms.label: Crop
terms.definition: A cultivated plant population or crop type managed for agricultural production.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Use for crop-management relevance; Commodity and canonical crop records remain separate future models.

terms.label: Livestock operation
terms.definition: A production operation managing farmed animals.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Use for livestock-enterprise relevance; exclude wildlife and companion-animal contexts.

terms.label: Agronomist
terms.definition: A professional advising or managing crop, soil and production practices.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Use for professional agronomic relevance; exclude general researchers without an advisory or production role.

terms.label: Cooperative
terms.definition: A member-owned organization serving producers or rural participants.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Use for cooperative operational or member relevance; specific cooperatives are represented later as Organizations.

terms.label: Agribusiness
terms.definition: A commercial organization operating in agricultural inputs, production, processing or distribution.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Use for broad agricultural-business relevance; specific companies are represented as Organizations.

terms.label: Input supplier
terms.definition: An organization supplying agricultural seeds, nutrients, protection products, feed, machinery or related inputs.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Use where input supply is materially relevant; exclude general retailers without agricultural-input activity.

terms.label: Food processor
terms.definition: An organization transforming agricultural materials into food ingredients or products.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Use for processing operations; exclude primary producers and retail-only organizations.

terms.label: Trader
terms.definition: An actor buying, selling or intermediating agricultural or food goods.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Use for commercial trading relevance; exclude logistics providers that do not take a trading role.

terms.label: Policymaker
terms.definition: A public decision-maker responsible for policy, regulation or program design.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Use for governmental decision relevance; specific agencies remain Organizations.

terms.label: Researcher
terms.definition: A person or institution producing systematic agricultural, market or contextual knowledge.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Use for research relevance; exclude operational advisers unless research use is material.

terms.label: Market
terms.definition: A defined exchange environment for agricultural goods, inputs or related services.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Use for market-level relevance; canonical markets and market data are deferred to a later phase.

terms.label: Decision-support system
terms.definition: A system that may consume contextual intelligence to support an operational decision.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Use only to mark potential relevance; classification must not execute or generate a recommendation.

terms.label: FlahaSOIL
terms.definition: The Flaha capability responsible for soil-focused analysis and operational soil information.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Use only for potential soil-related relevance; FlahaINTEL does not invoke or write FlahaSOIL results.

terms.label: FlahaFAST
terms.definition: The Flaha capability responsible for its approved rapid agricultural workflows and outputs.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Use only for potential relevance; no FlahaFAST workflow is started by classification.

terms.label: FlahaCALC
terms.definition: The Flaha capability responsible for approved agricultural calculations and derived outputs.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Use only for potential calculation relevance; FlahaINTEL does not request or generate FlahaCALC results.
